purpose: Freeze the exact nonuniform refinement families before H0 implementation and execution.

alternating.unnormalized_dt_factor: 0.5 for even zero-based interval index, 1.5 for odd zero-based interval index
alternating.normalization: multiply all factors by T/sum(factors) so t_N=T exactly
alternating.reason: preserves a persistent factor-three local timestep contrast while refining the whole grid

geometric.unnormalized_dt: dt_i = r_N^i for zero-based interval index i
geometric.normalization: multiply all dt_i by T/sum(dt_i) so t_N=T exactly
geometric.refinement_property: r_N tends to 1 as N increases, so the largest interval also tends to zero rather than preserving a coarse tail interval

hard_rules: No grid family or ratio formula may change after first H0 execution.
The source-faithful H0 operator remains the precommitted midpoint Eq. 5 sum; this file changes only the deterministic test-grid construction.
Analytic continuous half-order histories are comparison references and must not replace the published discrete midpoint sum.
